plugins.name: semantic-sidekick
plugins.description: Activation + routing + capture layer on top of a markdown vault MCP. Hooks search on every prompt; skills route between vault-first / research / outage-silence modes; apply_patch / synthesize_note / ingest_source turn query-answers into durable artifacts with provenance. Turns a retrievable vault into a present knowledge prosthesis.
